descriptionHtml:
AMD Ryzen 5 7500F 6-Core 12-Thread Desktop Processor (Socket AM5 / 3.7GHz Base Clock / Up to 5.0GHz Max Boost / 32MB L3 Cache / 65W TDP / Zen 4 Architecture / TSMC 5nm FinFET / PCIe 5.0 Support / DDR5 Memory / 1-Year Store Warranty)

Upgrade to the next generation of PC gaming with the AMD Ryzen 5 7500F desktop processor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a 1-Year store warranty. Powered by the groundbreaking Zen 4 architecture on TSMC 5nm process technology, this AM5 processor features 6 cores and 12 threads with a boost frequency up to 5.0GHz. Designed for maximum efficiency with a 65W TDP, it offers full support for high-speed DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0 expansion lanes, and a generous 32MB L3 cache for unmatched competitive gaming and multi-tasking performance.
